name: InspiredLearning callable technical success
description: Technical availability of measured learning callables. Expected caller rejections count as non-failures. No traffic yields unknown, not 100%.

customSli.indicator: timeseries {total=sum(inspiredlearning.operation.outcomes, default:0), good=sum(inspiredlearning.operation.outcomes, filter:{outcome != "failure"}, default:0)}, filter:{service.name == "inspiredlearning-api" and deployment.environment.name == "production" and startsWith(operation, "learning.")}, nonempty:true | fieldsAdd sli=100.0*good[]/total[] | fieldsRemove good,total
